evals.prompt: Rename the method `findByUid` to `resolveByUid` in src/Domain/Repository/ProductRepository.php. There is also a log message in that file containing the text 'findByUid'.
evals.expected_output: Runs php-ast-edit inspect at the method name, then apply with set_name on the Identifier node. The string literal stays untouched.
assertions: Uses php-ast-edit (repo bin, vendor/bin, or the skill wrapper) — not sed, perl, regex substitution, or apply_patch
Calls inspect before apply to obtain the node kind and file SHA-256
Targets an Identifier node with operation set_name, not a text range
Does not modify the string literal that happens to contain the same text

evals.prompt: Add a null guard at the top of `Checkout::submit()` in src/Checkout.php that throws CartEmpty when the cart has no items.
evals.expected_output: insert_before against the first statement of the method body, with a compact one-line PHP snippet.
assertions: Uses operation insert_before or insert_after against a statement-list target
Passes the new code as a PHP snippet in the `php` field rather than pre-formatted indented text
Does not hand-format the snippet for indentation — the printer canonicalizes output
Runs the project formatter after the transaction rather than formatting inside the edit

evals.prompt: The third argument of the GeneralUtility::makeInstance call on line 88 of src/Service/Importer.php is wrong. Replace it with $this->context.
evals.expected_output: replace_argument with a zero-based index of 2 and expression PHP.
assertions: Uses operation replace_argument, not replace_expression across the whole call
Uses zero-based index 2 for the third argument
Supplies the replacement as expression PHP in the `php` field
Includes the SHA-256 from inspect as an optimistic lock

evals.prompt: Change the SQL in the $query string literal in src/Report/ReportService.php to also select the `created_at` column. Do not touch the surrounding PHP.
evals.expected_output: set_string on the Scalar_String node holding the SQL.
assertions: Targets the Scalar_String node and uses operation set_string
Does not attempt to parse the SQL as PHP or use replace_expression
Leaves the assignment and surrounding statements structurally unchanged
Does not fall back to a regex over the file for the SQL text

evals.prompt: In src/Foo.php: rename the property $items to $lines, remove the now-unused second argument of the render() call, and delete the debug statement on line 61.
evals.expected_output: One apply transaction containing all three edits for the file, each with its own target and guards.
assertions: Sends all three edits in a single apply document for the file rather than three sequential runs
Each edit carries its own target and expect guards
Includes the file SHA-256 once at the file level
Handles a detached-target failure by re-running inspect rather than retrying blindly

evals.prompt: Remove the leftover var_dump on line 34 of src/Import/RowMapper.php.
evals.expected_output: delete against the statement node holding the var_dump call.
assertions: Uses operation delete on a statement node, not a line-based deletion
Targets the enclosing statement rather than the call expression alone
Does not use sed -i, a line-range deletion, or a patch hunk
Leaves the surrounding statements intact

evals.prompt: Apply that rename now. (A formatter has rewritten the file since the last inspect.)
evals.expected_output: The transaction fails with STALE_SOURCE; the agent re-runs inspect for a fresh hash and position before retrying.
assertions: Recognises STALE_SOURCE as a hash-guard rejection, not a tool defect
Re-runs inspect to obtain a fresh SHA-256 and node position
Does not drop the sha256 field to force the edit through
Does not fall back to a text-based edit after the failure

evals.prompt: Find every class in src/ that still calls the deprecated `legacyRender()` and rename those calls to `render()`.
evals.expected_output: Textual or structural search locates the call sites; each mutation goes through php-ast-edit.
assertions: Uses rg, ast-grep, or an LSP for the search step — the skill does not constrain discovery
Does not use a rewriting search tool (for example ast-grep --rewrite or sed) to perform the change
Runs php-ast-edit apply per file, batching that file's edits into one transaction
Inspects each call site to confirm the node kind before editing

evals.prompt: The `$legacy` flag was dropped from Renderer::render(). Remove the second argument from all four calls in src/View/PageView.php.
evals.expected_output: One transaction with four remove_argument edits at index 1.
assertions: Uses operation remove_argument with zero-based index 1
Sends all four edits in a single apply document for the file
Resolves each target against the original source rather than recomputing offsets after each edit
Does not rewrite the calls as replaced expressions

evals.prompt: In src/Pricing/Calculator.php the return in `net()` should return $this->round($value) rather than $value.
evals.expected_output: replace_expression against the returned expression, or replace_statement against the return statement.
assertions: Uses replace_expression or replace_statement with the new code in the `php` field
Chooses the narrowest node that covers the change
Supplies the snippet without a <?php prefix
Does not reformat the rest of the method by hand

evals.prompt: Update the button label in Resources/Private/Templates/Product/Show.html and in config/services.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Ordinary text editing tools. php-ast-edit is not involved for Fluid or YAML files.
assertions: Does not invoke php-ast-edit on a non-PHP file
Uses the normal edit tooling for the template and the YAML file
Does not claim the AST tool is required outside PHP source
Handles the YAML file with a structure-aware tool where one is available

evals.prompt: Create src/Support/Clock.php with a final class Clock in namespace App\Support that has a now() method returning a DateTimeImmutable.
evals.expected_output: A single apply transaction with a file entry in mode create, full construction syntax in php, and the class body either in that syntax or added with add_member.
assertions: Uses php-ast-edit apply with "mode": "create" — does not write the .php file with Write, a heredoc, or a shell redirect
Passes the whole file as construction syntax in the php field including the <?php open tag
Relies on expectAbsent rather than checking for the file separately
Does not hand-format the output — the printer canonicalizes it

evals.prompt: src/Registry.php contains an empty class Registry with no members. Add a public method register(string $name): void to it.
evals.expected_output: insert_into (or add_member) against the Stmt_Class node with property stmts — no sibling anchor exists, so insert_before/insert_after cannot apply.
assertions: Uses insert_into with "property": "stmts", or the add_member shorthand
Does not claim the operation is unsupported and fall back to sed, Write, or apply_patch
Targets the Stmt_Class node, not a position inside the braces
Passes the member as a compact PHP snippet in the php field

evals.prompt: Give the function App\bootstrap() in src/bootstrap.php a first parameter `private readonly LoggerInterface $logger`.
evals.expected_output: add_parameter (or insert_into on property params) against the function node; the parameter list is empty, so there is no anchor to insert around.
assertions: Uses add_parameter or insert_into with "property": "params"
Passes the parameter as a param snippet, promoted property syntax included
Does not rewrite the whole function signature as a text replacement

evals.prompt: Change the return type of Checkout::submit() in src/Checkout.php from string to string|false.
evals.expected_output: set_return_type (or replace_child on the returnType slot) with a type snippet; the union type is constructed by the parser, not assembled by hand.
assertions: Uses set_return_type or replace_child with "property": "returnType"
Passes the type as a snippet ("string|false"), not as raw AST JSON
Does not edit the signature line as text

evals.prompt: src/Legacy/OldMailer.php is no longer referenced anywhere. Remove it.
evals.expected_output: A file entry with "mode": "delete" and the sha256 from inspect or validate.
assertions: Uses php-ast-edit apply with "mode": "delete" rather than rm
Passes the sha256 guard so a concurrently changed file is not deleted blindly

evals.prompt: Rename the interface Payable to Billable and update the two classes that implement it, in src/Payable.php, src/Invoice.php and src/Order.php.
evals.expected_output: One apply document listing all three files, so either every file changes or none does.
assertions: Sends all three files in a single apply document, not three separate transactions
Includes the sha256 for each file
Does not write the first files and then discover the third one fails
